receipts.reason: One claim is false at 3586a0d: mypy with 6.12.1's stubs finds chatmon/app.py:3173: error: Argument 1 to "removeEventFilter" of "QObject" has incompatible type "Companion"; expected "AskBox"  [arg-type], the crash fix's new widget.removeEventFilter(self) in Companion._stop_for_good. 6.12.1's stubs type the filter as Self, the watched object, the stub bug CONTRIBUTING.md's third workaround covers; the line has no # type: ignore[arg-type].
